v29-5.candidate: Is this not David, for whom they led the song in the dances, saying: ‘Saul has struck his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”
v29-5.display:
Is this not David, for whom they led the song in the dances, saying:
‘Saul has struck his thousands,
and David his tens of thousands’?”

v29-6.candidate: Achish called David and said to him, “As the Lord lives, you are upright and good in my eyes, as are your going out and coming in with me in the camp. For I have found no evil against you from the day you came to me until today. But in the satraps’ eyes you are not good.
